## Useful commands

### To enter as python interactive to test quries:
```bash
docker exec -it proj-fantasysv-fastapi-1 bash -c "python -i -m app.main"
```

### To delete pycache files generated by the container
```
# Preview what will be deleted
find backend | grep -E "__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|\.pyc"

# Delete
sudo find backend -type d \( -name "__pycache__" -o -name ".pytest_cache" \) -exec rm -rf {} +
sudo find backend -type f -name "*.pyc" -delete
```
